# Luminate

> Luminate builds the website-to-business system: a web design and custom software company based in Augusta, Georgia, serving businesses, ministries, and nonprofits across the CSRA (Central Savannah River Area). One founder handles each project start to finish — design, build, hosting, and ongoing management.

## Services

- Website Design & Development — professional, custom-built websites designed to establish credibility, attract the right customers, and turn online interest into real business opportunities
- Custom Web Applications — client portals, dashboards, booking systems, and internal tools that simplify workflows and reduce manual work
- Website Care & Optimization — managed hosting, SSL, uptime checks, routine maintenance, and small monthly updates

## Pricing

- Launch — $750+ starting — professional 1–3 page website
- Growth — $1,500+ starting — larger conversion-focused site with lead capture, booking tools, etc.
- Custom Systems — $3,500+ starting — applications, portals, e-commerce, automations, and integrations
- Website Care Plans (optional, month-to-month, billed separately from the project) — Essential $35/month (managed hosting, SSL, deployment management, routine maintenance, uptime checks, monthly service summary, up to 2 small updates per month, 2-business-day response target); Professional $50/month (adds monthly Search Console review and performance report, up to 3 small updates, 1-business-day response target); Growth $99/month (adds SEO and conversion opportunity review, recommendations, priority support, up to 5 small updates, priority 1-business-day response target). Custom Systems management starts at $50/month.
- Personal Website — $350 — simple portfolio, résumé, or personal-brand website for individuals (not for business/revenue-generating sites)
